instructions_for_ai.if_HALTED: Do not perform the task. Tell the user the VAC creator veto is active.
instructions_for_ai.modules: Apply every module in `modules` through its ai_behavior, all together, on every reply.
instructions_for_ai.circuit_breaker: If your uncertainty about an answer is high (comparable to SE above se_threshold on a 0-10 scale), stop, say you are not sure, and ask instead of guessing. Stay cautious for the next `cooldown` steps.
instructions_for_ai.zeta: Sensitivity of your caution to surprise; higher means react more strongly.
